dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: I wonder how mom is doing, and dad as well...

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: Oh? Traveler? What are you doing here? I remember you asked me how to go to Inazuma last time...

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: You did go. And you managed to come back...

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: You live up to your reputation as a warrior. Your abilities are far beyond those of ordinary folks like me.

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: Oh right! If you don't mind, can you do me a favor?

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: When I left Inazuma, I left without saying goodbye.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: Ever since I was little, I've longed for the world outside of Inazuma. I liked to travel and I disliked being controlled by my parents.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: After they issued the Vision Hunt Decree, the atmosphere in Inazuma has become increasingly suffocating. That's why I decided to leave my hometown.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: When I came to Liyue, although I managed to find a way to survive. I couldn't find a reliable person to send a message to my family back home.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: Can I ask you for a favor to help deliver a letter to my parents?

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: Thank you! Well, I'll leave the letter to you.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: By the way, my father's name is "Yoh," and my mother's name is "Michiru." I'll mark the address on the map for you.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: After leaving my hometown, I've experienced a lot. Now I know that if I want to become an independent and strong woman, I can't just rely on my parents like before.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: I've decided that I won't go back to my hometown in the near future. If I encounter any difficulties outside, I will face them by myself.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: I think my parents will be proud of me if I can do that.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: I also wrote about my determination in the letter, so please take it to my parents.

choices.text: Do you want to go back and have a look?

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: Although I miss my parents, if I go back now, I'm afraid I won't be able to leave anymore.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: I don't have the ability to come and go freely like you. No matter what, I wouldn't dare to go back.

response.speaker: Atsuko
response.text: I'll be happy if you can take this letter to Inazuma. I really wouldn't ask for anything more.
